# deps: tools: remove git-vertag

Remove `git-vertag` ([#367](DOT-366.md)) from the Go toolset. **Motivation:** no reaction to [kyoh86/git-vertag#14](https://github.com/kyoh86/git-vertag/issues/14), the request for a Go-module-compatible `v2` path; without it the tool could only be pinned to an old pseudo-version ([#380](DOT-379.md), [#385](DOT-384.md)), which violated the toolset's "tagged releases only" rule ([#383](DOT-382.md)).
